headline: Going Commando reaches 7,100 matched functions
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 decompilation reached 7,100 of 8,578 functions and 65.83% matched code by size. Matching means the reconstructed code compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. An 842-function contribution followed smaller reviewed batches, while build changes let concurrent programs use separate Wine environments.
highlights: An 842-function batch covers boot and level code, accounting for 609,116 bytes in USA v1.01 (#368).
Reviewed contributions add 21 functions, then another 15 through integration (#364, #366).
The progress calculation now counts fully linked code from complete units (#369).
